title: Design: Phone work order header has the orange style and the badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer and asset, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost (for example $95.00), the line In Progress, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow4-08-08-mobile-detail-header.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header shows the "Internal" badge next to the status, with an orange outline and a light orange background.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R3: “The work order header shows one badge next to the status: "Internal" for an internal work order, "No Charge" for a no-charge work order (a different style from Internal), in the desktop and the mobile header. It is the only mark on the work order: the customer card on the detail page shows no badge and no category. On the detail page the header card of an internal or no-charge work order has an orange outline and a light orange background (a new style for the header card, on desktop and on the mobile header; the design authority names the token), so the work order is recognised at a glance; there is no hint sentence under the header. The category of a no-charge work order is not shown on the work order; it is in the Change category dialog, on the NO CHARGE document and in the report (S2-R16). A billable work order that carries no-charge lines carries no badge and no header style; the line carries the mark (Story 12).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders", board "08 Mobile · detail header" (Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders).
